description.narrative: The 'Powering Agricultural Support task order' (PASTO) supports the management and evaluation of "Powering Agriculture: An Energy Grand Challenge for Development (PAEGC)" awards. PASTO serves to accelerate the deployment of new clean energy solutions for increasing agricultural productivity in developing countries. PAEGC provides technical leadership by inspiring new and sustainable approaches to apply clean energy solutions to the agricultural sector. The 'Powering Agriculture Support' task order will strengthen the management of awards made under Powering Agriculture: An Energy Grand Challenge for Development (PAEGC). PAEGC aims to reduce emissions globally through developing and deploying new clean energy solutions for increasing agricultural productivity.
